devdoc.details: Contract that allows PDT holders to claim rewards in blue-chip Web3 game tokens.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

AddressInsufficientBalance(address).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

params.rewardToken: The address of already registered reward token

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

params.nextEpochId: The epoch id to be started

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC20 token failed.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

params.epochId: The epoch id which staking is happened in
params.to: Address of who is receiving credit of stake

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

params.epochId: The epoch id which unstaking is happened in
The epoch Id that the epoch length is updated in
The epoch Id that the rewardsExpiryThreshold is updated in
params.newRewardsExpiryThreshold: The new number of epochs in which rewards are claimable
params.previousRewardsExpiryThreshold: The previous number of epochs in which rewards are claimable

params.amount: The amount of withdrawn reward tokens

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params.to: The address to send rewards to Emits a {Claim} event.

params.epochId: Id of epoch wanting to get `claimable_` for
params.rewardToken: The address of reward token to get claimable amount of

params.firstEpochStartIn: The duration of seconds the first epoch will starts in
params.initialEpochLength: The duration of each epoch in seconds
params.name: The name of receipt token

params.epochId: Epoch to return total weight of contract for

returns.contractWeight_: Weight of contract at the end of `epochId`

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRoleMember(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns one of the accounts that have `role`. `index` must be a value between 0 and {getRoleMemberCount}, non-inclusive. Role bearers are not sorted in any particular way, and their ordering may change at any point. WARNING: When using {getRoleMember} and {getRoleMemberCount}, make sure you perform all queries on the same block. See the following https://forum.openzeppelin.com/t/iterating-over-elements-on-enumerableset-in-openzeppelin-contracts/2296[forum post] for more information.

getRoleMemberCount(bytes32).details: Returns the number of accounts that have `role`. Can be used together with {getRoleMember} to enumerate all bearers of a role.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

params.rewardToken: The address of reward token to get pending reward amount of

returns.pendingRewards_: Current pending rewards of a specific reward token for next epoch

params.newRewardToken: The address of reward token Requirements: - Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can register new reward token - `newRewardToken` shouldn't be a zero address - `newRewardToken` shouldn't be already registered Emits a {RegisterNewRewardToken} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.amount: The amount of PDT to stake. Requirements: - should stake during the current epoch is live. - `to` shouldn't be zero address. - `amount` shouldn't be zero. Emits a {Stake} event.
params.to: The address that will receive credit for stake.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: stPDT is soulbound, but can be transferred from/to whitelisted contracts. Requirements - Only whitelisted contract can call this function Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: stPDT is soulbound, but can be transferred from/to whitelisted contracts. Requirements - Only whitelisted contract can call this function - `to` should be a whitelisted contract address Emits a {Transfer} event.

params.index: Index of reward token address to remove Requirements: - Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can unregister reward token Emits an {UnregisterRewardToken} event.

params.amount: The amount of PDT to unstake. Requirements: - should unstake during the current epoch is live. * - `to` shouldn't be zero address. - `amount` shouldn't be zero. - should unstake not more than staked amount. Emits an {Unstake} event.
params.to: The address that will receive PDT unstaked.

params.newEpochLength: New epoch length in seconds Requirements: - Only EPOCH_MANAGER can update epoch length - `newEpochLength` shouldn't be zero - `newEpochLength` shouldn't be the same as `epochLength` - Updated epoch end time should be greater than `contractLastInteraction` Emits an {UpdateEpochLength} event.

params.newRewardsExpiryThreshold: The number of epochs in which rewards are claimable Requirements: - Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can update rewards expiry threshold - `rewardsExpiryThreshold` change shouldn't apply to epochs that have happened before the change Emits an {UpdateRewardsExpiryThreshold} event.

params.shouldWhitelist: Boolean if `value` should be whitelisted or not Requirements: - Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can update contract whitelist Emits {UpdateWhitelistedContract} event.

params.epochId: Epoch id to calculate weight of `user`
params.user: Address to calculate `userWeight_` of for epoch `epochId`

params.amount: The amount of the reward tokens to withdraw Requirements: - Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can withdraw reward tokens - `rewardToken` should be already registered - `amount` shouldn't be zero Emits a {WithdrawRewardToken} event.
params.rewardToken: The address of the reward token

whitelistedContracts.details: stPDT is not allowed to be transferred to non-whitelisted addresses except for minting and burning cases.

ClaimedUpToEpoch().notice: Can't claim if rewards are already claimed up to current epoch

EmptyRewardPool(uint256).notice: Can't distribute if reward pool for the next epoch is not ready

InvalidRewardsExpiryThreshold().notice: The number of rewards expiry threshold can't be zero

InvalidStakesTransfer().notice: Can't transfer zero amount of stakes, or to non-whitelisted addresses.

OutOfEpoch().notice: Can't stake/unstake if the current epoch has ended

Distribute(uint256).notice: Emitted if a new epoch is started

RegisterNewRewardToken(uint256,address).notice: Emitted if a reward token is registered

UnregisterRewardToken(uint256,address).notice: Emitted if a reward token is unregistered

UpdateEpochLength(uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: Emitted if epoch length is updated

UpdateRewardsExpiryThreshold(uint256,uin.notice: Emitted upon owner updates reward duration

UpdateWhitelistedContract(address,bool).notice: Emitted if a contract address is whitelisted or not

WithdrawRewardToken(address,uint256).notice: Emitted upon the owner withdraw reward tokens

claim(address).notice: Claims all pending rewards for msg.sender. Claiming rewards is available just once per epoch.

claimAmountForEpoch(address,uint256,addr.notice: Returns `user`'s claimable amount of rewards for `epochId`

contractLastInteraction().notice: Timestamp of lastest stake/unstake action on contract

contractWeight().notice: Returns current total weight of contract

contractWeightAtEpoch(uint256).notice: Returns total weight of contract at `epochId`

distribute().notice: Update epoch details if time Requirements: - Only EPOCH_MANAGER can end current epoch and start new one - Reward pool for the next epoch shouldn't be empty - Current epoch's end time should be already passed Emits a {Distribute} event.

pendingRewards(address).notice: Returns current pending rewards of a specific reward token for next epoch

stakeDetails(address).notice: Mapping of accounts to their stake details

unregisterRewardToken(uint256).notice: Unregister a reward token from reward token list

updateRewardsExpiryThreshold(uint256).notice: Update the number of epochs in which rewards are claimable

updateWhitelistedContract(address,bool).notice: Whitelist contract addresses where stPDT tokens can be transferred to.

userWeightAtEpoch(address,uint256).notice: Returns total weight of `user` at epoch `epochId`

whitelistedContracts(address).notice: Mapping of contract addresses to their whitelisted status

withdrawRewardTokens(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw idle reward tokens. Idle reward amount should be calculated from off-chain side.
